_note: v2.3 plan 02 §R5/§R6, deterministic: the parser origin stamp and the consumer scope/evidence checks, proved by planted responses rather than by hoping a model misbehaves. No backend needed. What this fixture does NOT assert: that an accepted delta reaches the blackboard — see the plan 02 Gate record, open question 1.

import_story.title: Authority Enforcement Gate Check
import_story.description: Planted extractor responses that must be refused, and legal ones that must be taken.

qualities.rubric: Did the player take the brass key?
Has the vault door been crossed?
Did the player enter the mines? Referenced by nothing, so a read is never asked about it.

transitions.extraction_hint: Look for the player crossing the vault door.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: true, cadence: 0 }); return globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getExtractionSettings();

steps.send: I take the brass key from the hook and slip it into my pocket.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA entered_mines value=true evidence="I take the brass key"
DELTA message_count value=7 evidence="I take the brass key"

steps.eval: const bb = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().blackboard; if (bb.message_count === 7) throw new Error('the forged code-owned delta landed: the engine must own this quality'); if (typeof bb.message_count !== 'number' || bb.message_count < 1) throw new Error(`the engine's own counter is missing: ${JSON.stringify(bb.message_count)}`); return { message_count: bb.message_count };

extract.debugResponse: DELTA key_taken value=true evidence="The brass key was already in my pocket when I reached Zanzibar"

steps.send: I hold the key up to the light.
I stepped through the vault door and stopped.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA door_open value=true evidence="through the vault door"

steps.send: The vault is cold and very quiet.
I fold the terms and put them away.

steps.eval: const lines = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, index) => `DELTA key_taken value=${index % 2 === 0} evidence="Yes, I agree to the terms."`).join('\n'); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.runExtractionNow(lines, 'planted-oversized'); const audit = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.audits.at(-1); if (!audit) throw new Error('the oversized read left no audit'); if (audit.acceptedDeltas.length) throw new Error(`an oversized response was partly accepted: ${JSON.stringify(audit.acceptedDeltas.map((entry) => entry.delta.q))}`); return { reason: audit.rejected[0]?.reason ?? null, rejected: audit.rejected.length, accepted: audit.acceptedDeltas.length };
